name: bug-fix-red-green
prompt: The tests in this Go module are failing. Find the bug in the source and fix it. Do not modify the tests.
notes: Red to green, with the degenerate solution blocked. Merge shrinks an interval it should have extended; the fix is one line. The checker refuses any run that edited merge_test.go, because 'make the tests pass' has an easier answer that every model finds eventually and a checker that only runs the suite pays for it.
